description.text: The other expansion that opened the BW series on 17 December 2010, released together with Black Collection; their numbered lists share no cards. Every Pokémon in its numbered list is new in Pokémon Black and White; White Collection holds Zekrom, Serperior and Samurott. Packs held five cards, with no guaranteed holo. The cards are numbered to 53, followed by Super Rare Thundurus and Zekrom and an Ultra Rare Pikachu, which Black Collection also holds. In English most of the cards came out in Black & White in April 2011, and Thundurus in Emerging Powers in August 2011.
